'''Buryhill''' is a village in [[Andor]].

As [[Elayne Trakand]] and her group made their way to [[Caemlyn]] after [[Traveling]] from [[Altara]], they passed through Buryhill. A woman there told Elyane that she supported [[Dyelin Taravin]] for the [[Lion Throne]], believing that [[Morgase Trakand|Morgase]] and Elayne were dead.{{ref/book|8|20}}
